$comment: Mission 1.76. Candidate next moves, generated ONLY from facts the repository already holds. No source was discovered, nothing was acquired, and no candidate was invented to make the table look richer.

candidates.title: Bind the Wikimedia measurement resource so the reviewed reliability resolves
candidates.subject_id: wikimedia content ids: Docker_(software), Kubernetes, Podman
candidates.opportunity_relevance: six of the seven Evidence rows linked to the only Opportunity are Wikimedia pageview rows
candidates.why_no_dimension: this move adds no dimension and does not pretend to. It makes evidence the corpus already holds usable by aggregation, which is a different kind of gain and is recorded as one.
candidates.governance_note: wikimedia-pageviews carries a LOCAL review with 3 unsatisfied conditions, which blocks NEW COLLECTION. This move collects nothing: it reads records already held under the review that authorised collecting them.
candidates.held_data_availability: 21 normalized records, 37 Evidence rows, all already held
candidates.independence_note: unchanged by this move. Reliability and independence are different questions and this answers only the first.
candidates.why_decision_changing: the Opportunity's FIRST named epistemic limitation is that every supporting Evidence row is NON_SCORABLE because no reviewed reliability applies. A reviewed assessment for exactly this measurement and purpose ALREADY EXISTS at 0.65 and 0.6. What stops it applying is that the Evidence cannot state its resource identity, so resolve_reliability returns NO_APPLICABLE_ASSESSMENT with the detail 'this evidence record cannot state its measurement-and-purpose scope'. Aggregation over this hypothesis is impossible today and becomes reachable.
known_blockers: the seventh linked Evidence row is stack-exchange, whose scope has no assessment, so the packet becomes PARTLY scorable and not wholly
resource_id is absent from the whole acquisition lineage and appears only in the assessment and, for other sources, inside proposition_facts

the 34 Wikimedia claims are frozen and their proposition_key is derived from proposition_facts, so editing them to add resource_id would change claim identity. The move must resolve at read time from the committed collector constant rather than rewriting frozen claims
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: one deterministic binding step: map the held collector lineage (collector_id 'wikimedia-pageviews-per-article', one collector, one resource) to the committed WM_RESOURCE_ID constant, then apply the repository's own resolve_reliability. No migration, no new vocabulary, no model.
candidates.why_it_could_change_a_downstream_decisio: no aggregation is possible over this hypothesis at all today. After the move, aggregation over its Wikimedia rows is possible, and the Opportunity's leading stated limitation stops being true as written.
candidates.why_it_might_fail: if resource identity turns out not to be deterministically recoverable for every held Wikimedia record, the binding would be an assignment rather than a derivation, and assigning a resource to a record that does not state one is inventing lineage. The move must refuse in that case rather than proceed.

candidates.title: Apply the already-resolving TED reliability to its Evidence rows
candidates.subject_id: EU public procurement notices, CPV division 90
candidates.opportunity_relevance: none: no TED Evidence row is linked to the Opportunity
candidates.why_no_dimension: the dimension is already present in these rows; only scorability is not
candidates.governance_note: ted-eu is the one source with a LOCAL review and zero unsatisfied conditions
candidates.held_data_availability: 12 Evidence rows across 10 claims, all already held
candidates.subject_relationship_note: these rows are about procurement notices for cleaning and sanitation services (CPV division 90). No established scope relation attaches them to the Docker subject, and looking related is not a relation.
candidates.commercial_note: market activity, and nothing more. A published notice value is neither actual spend nor a framework maximum nor willingness to pay for any product hypothesis, and this record does not collapse them.
candidates.why_this_gain: it would make 12 rows scorable, and no current Opportunity uses them. Scorable evidence attached to no hypothesis changes no decision that exists.
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: the same binding step as M1, which TED does not need
candidates.why_it_could_change_a_downstream_decisio: it could not, today. It would prepare TED evidence for a hypothesis that does not exist yet.
candidates.why_it_might_fail: it cannot fail; it is simply not decision-relevant now

candidates.title: Reliability review for the Stack Exchange tagged-question scope
candidates.opportunity_relevance: the seventh and only non-Wikimedia Evidence row on the Opportunity
candidates.why_no_dimension: the dimension is already supported; the row cannot be scored
candidates.governance_note: APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS under LOCAL with 1 blocking reason recorded. The review itself needs first-party documentation, which is a retrieval this mission did not perform and did not authorise.
candidates.held_data_availability: 2 Evidence rows, 104 normalized records of which 16 feed no signal
candidates.independence_note: Stack Exchange and Wikimedia are different publishers measuring different things, which is diversity. Whether the lineages are independent is a review nobody has done, and 'different company' is not independence evidence.
candidates.why_this_gain: on its own it makes one of seven linked rows scorable and does not close the stated blocker. Together with M1 it would complete the packet, but a mission is judged on what it does alone.
known_blockers: an assessment must rest on at least one retrieved first-party document, so this requires an external documentation retrieval next mission
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: one human review against the existing rubric, no code
candidates.why_it_could_change_a_downstream_decisio: it would make the Opportunity's only problem-or-need row scorable, which no other move does.
candidates.why_it_might_fail: the reviewer may conclude the measurement's scope cannot be bounded, and a refusal is a legitimate outcome of a review.

candidates.title: Derive claims from the 120 held TED normalized records that feed no signal
candidates.why_no_dimension: the same lineage and the same proposition kinds already present
candidates.held_data_availability: 120 of 188 TED normalized records feed no signal
candidates.independence_note: one publisher, one resource, one collector: the same lineage repeated
candidates.why_this_gain: more rows of a dimension and lineage the corpus already has
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: a derivation run over held records
candidates.why_it_could_change_a_downstream_decisio: it could not; MORE ROWS IS NOT MORE INFORMATION

candidates.title: Derive claims from the 16 held Stack Exchange records that feed no signal
candidates.opportunity_relevance: same dimension as the Opportunity's existing problem-or-need row
candidates.held_data_availability: 16 of 104 Stack Exchange normalized records feed no signal
candidates.why_this_gain: a larger question count is not a different kind of fact, and whether any two questions share a problem is PARKED
known_blockers: the same missing assessment as M3
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: a derivation run over held records

candidates.title: Bounded LOCAL governance review for one developer-ecosystem source
candidates.opportunity_relevance: would target dimensions the Opportunity explicitly records as unsupported
candidates.governance_note: none of the developer-family sources has ANY review under local-private-research-v1. Under Mission 1.75's contract an absent review is a refusal, and the commercial profile's state may not be borrowed -- github is RESTRICTED there, which says nothing about LOCAL.
candidates.subject_relationship_note: a repository or package named for Docker is not established to be the same subject as the Wikipedia article or the Stack Overflow tag. That relation would need the scope machinery and has not been established.
candidates.why_this_gain: the dimension it could add is genuinely absent, and whether it would arrive at all cannot be bounded from held facts: no review, no collector, no normalizer and no established subject relation. UNKNOWN is the honest class, and it is not a synonym for promising.
known_blockers: no LOCAL policy review exists for any developer-family source
no collector is implemented for any of them
the subject relation to the current Docker subject is UNDETERMINED
candidates.estimated_engineering_shape: a governance review, then a collector, then a normalizer
candidates.why_it_could_change_a_downstream_decisio: it targets dimensions the Opportunity names as unsupported, which is where the hypothesis is actually thin.
candidates.why_it_might_fail: the review may refuse, the subject relation may not be establishable, and three sequential steps is not one bounded mission.

eliminated_before_ranking.title: An independent Globalping measurement experiment
eliminated_before_ranking.why: C9 remains PARTIAL and the counterpart is COUNTERPART_UNRESOLVED, so no route is qualified. It is recorded as a DEPENDENCY, not a candidate: a future qualification could unlock an independent measurement, and this mission may not select it.

eliminated_before_ranking.title: Any unregistered source that could supply willingness-to-pay
eliminated_before_ranking.why: no registered source can speak to WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY for this hypothesis, and this mission may not introduce one. Recorded as REGISTERED_SOURCE_GAP.

registered_source_gap.$comment: The dimensions no registered source can currently reach.
registered_source_gap.why: the eight sources reviewed under local-private-research-v1 are two knowledge sources, one forum, one news source, one procurement source and three economic-data sources. None measures what an actor would pay, and procurement value is not willingness to pay for a product hypothesis.
